title: Lunar Site Planner: when a Moon lander gets sunlight and Earth contact
description: A free browser tool that shows, for a lander at a given Moon site and date, when the Sun and Earth are above the real terrain skyline (NASA LRO LOLA), how much solar power and radio contact that gives, and how to fly there. Checked against NASA JPL Horizons, NASA Goddard PGDA lighting maps, an LROC photo and Apollo landings. Validation: docs/VALIDATION.md. Public API: docs/API.md. Software developed with AI coding assistance.
